max_bytes.description: The largest content one file version may have, in bytes; a bigger `create` or result answers `too_large`.

busy_retries.description: How often a lost compare-and-swap of the head is tried again from the fresh head before the write answers `busy`.

diff_lines.description: The most lines of the `diff` a write answers with; a longer one is cut and says `truncated`.

overwrite_hint.description: An `overwrite` that changes at most this share of the lines answers with `hint: use_replace`.

description.purpose: The one place content is made in a file space: `create`, every write op of `in_write` against the main line (compare-and-swap on the caller's `base`, a moved base merged three-way or refused as `base_moved`) or against a workspace's working version (`hop.ws`), and the content requests of `./ws` on `in_put` (`merge3`, `patch`, `create`). Content becomes content-addressed blocks under an immutable version; `./guard` checks it before it lands unless `force`.
description.use_when: Inside a file space only, behind `in_write` and `in_put`.
description.not_in_scope: No read op (`./read`), no workspace lifecycle or commit (`./ws`), no summary or embedding (`./derive`).
description.emits_meaning: `write_store` to `./store` between phases; `answer` once per `in_write` request, `put` once per `in_put` request; `in_check` to `./guard`; `in_derive` to `./derive` once per move of the main line; `in_recover` to `./ws` when a due commit holds a file.
description.consumes_meaning: A request on `in_write` or `in_put`, the hook's answer on `checked`, and the store's answers to its own phases.
